record.question: How did you __________ this book?
record.explanation: Answer A: come by. Come by means acquire or obtain, so “How did you come by this book?” (A). Independent check: “Come by” can mean obtain/acquire, so “How did you come by this book?” is idiomatic. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/come%20by; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/come-by. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
